intents.name: ORDER_STATUS
intents.description: Customer wants to know the status or location of an existing order.
examples: Can you tell me when my package will arrive?
I haven't received my order, what's going on?
What's the status of order NS1042?

intents.name: RETURN_REQUEST
intents.description: Customer wants to return an item they purchased.
examples: I want to send this item back.
This product doesn't fit, can I return it?
I'd like a return label for my order.
Can I exchange this for a different size?

intents.name: REFUND_STATUS
intents.description: Customer wants to know the status of a refund already requested.
examples: When will I get my refund?
I returned an item, where's my money?
My refund hasn't shown up in my account yet.
Can you check on my refund for order NS1042?
